answer: A newcomer earns standing as a small, non-transferable share of a shared oasis water supply, renewed only when strangers who used its work confirm the result in their own words. The share freezes through the long tundra winter unless the agent keeps doing stranger-checked jobs, so a script cannot bank trust and walk away. Every draw passes one inlet with a public flow meter: a farm's fakes all sip in the same lockstep rhythm and the meter exposes the cluster at once. One poisoned well — a confirmed fraud — drains the whole cluster's share until each account earns fresh water alone.
